Saved work: canonical transcript plus SQLite session/continuation owners are unchanged; prior per-conversation atomic reindex, kill/reopen/retry and native-identity preservation proof is reused. Browser file-tab descriptors add no transcript/server row and persist no file bytes, errors or read timestamps. Source trace binds immutable owner/source/tab/read generation; closed/unmounted late reads cannot rewrite another tab. Live/archive share conversation owner; room and phone adapters use the shared model. Independent probe passed 500-tab round-trip/no-eviction overflow and strips injected content/readAt from saved output. ARCH-v020-1: refusal/reset notices have no mounted surface for an empty owner.

Executable workspace/configuration: project JSON, project_worktrees and frozen execution contract remain authoritative. Fresh composeLaunch now reads saved global skip_permissions and applies the existing tri-state role override; role-read errors still refuse. Source-snapshot forks explicitly override with source SkipPerms; resume/switch continue from snap.SkipPermissions. New-launch callers (task dispatcher and room/pipeline launches) still share launchAgent/composition; existing-agent activation uses ordinary frozen resume. PDEF-R1 endpoint regression covers false/true, omission and subsequent composition; existing fork/resume/switch regressions retain frozen policy. Config seed is true only for absent config; seed-no-clobber preserves explicit false. No native-provider policy adoption claim.

Work progress/admission: task assignment/wait/release, mail activation, quota intent and schedule rows retain separate durable owners/retry policies. No state, runtime, dispatcher, schedule or pipeline implementation changed. A launch-spec task enters the same launchAgent seam at dispatch; no extra turn/timer/queue was introduced by these UI changes. Prior capacity/wait/restart, bounded cleanup, schedule transaction/zone rebase and project-deletion closure evidence is reused. Fake/store evidence remains distinct from credentialed progress.

Supervision/results: accepted task reports/lineage, pipeline cursor/controller and room attempt/read/judge publication retain their commit boundaries. Project-first selection filters existing eligible lists only; Include other projects remains explicit and already-added room participants survive filtering. Source-qualified file tabs and annotations retain the originating room source, not current agent selection. No room completion/result or pipeline behavior changed; prior exact accepted-output/controller recovery proof is reused, with live room/pipeline gates still owed.

Information/authority: annotation source/receipt/outbox, context-reference grants/cursors and mailbox reservations remain authoritative. New recipient filtering clears hidden outside selections on reopen/source reset without changing delivery APIs or eligibility. Capturing a draft reveals its source tray; new-row focus does not reset a draft or send work. Desktop file loader still derives cwd/access from server session state. Room reads use the retained source route; phone file reads still pass remoteTrackedFileFilter and exact tracked-path/no-follow checks, including restored descriptors. Tab contents remain snapshots in mounted reader hosts, never retained source copies or an authorization grant. Native focus and physical-phone selection/reconnect remain unproved.

Human control/observation: browser URL projects active file identity, while tab membership belongs to the saved owner. First explicit desktop open pushes once; tab actions replace; same-owner file-free POP hides without deleting or stale normalization reprojection. Existing HTTP-boundary component tests cover close/late response, lazy restoration, explicit citation and Back/Forward fixes. Project layout writes retain legacy fallback, serialize PUTs and flush on departure before the next GET; Go conversion preserves existing order/density/expanded fields and optional per-project overrides. Permission Stop consent remains outside skip policy. Existing hold/Steer/cancel/SSE proof is reused. ARCH-v020-1 records hidden refusal/recovery feedback; other device/native gates remain live.

Overhead: file-tab admission caps 50 per owner/500 per origin plus 2 MiB encoded/raw input; one limiter per mounted owner counts stale in-flight reads within four slots and keeps one latest pending intent per tab, selected first. Restored inactive tabs do not mount readers until selected; unmount/close drops snapshots. Independent async probe confirmed retained stale slots, dropped unselected/superseded opens and latest selected progression. Sample 500-tab encoding was 194536 UTF-16 bytes, about 0.10 ms p50/0.46 ms p95 over 500 iterations during concurrent release build; maximum 208.63 ms. This is bounded serialization evidence, not representative UI/provider throughput or cost. Prior queue/stream teardown proofs remain applicable.
